buildCommand: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p /vercel/output/static && cp -r dist/. /vercel/output/static/ && printf '{"version":3,"routes":[{"src":"/assets/(.*)","headers":{"cache-control":"max-age=31536000, immutable"},"continue":true},{"handle":"filesystem"},{"src":"/(.*)","dest":"/index.html"}]}' > /vercel/output/config.json
